## How to choose the right company

Before booking, ask these three questions\:

- **What is the diagnostic or service-call fee?** Ask whether it is credited toward the repair.
- **Can you give me a written estimate before doing the work?** Request separate repair and replacement options if appropriate.
- **What warranty covers the parts and labor?** Get the terms in writing.

You can also verify the contractor's Arizona license through the [Arizona Registrar of Contractors](https://roc.az.gov/)\.
